result:
Round 268 passes. The one-line fix works in a real browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720 with no page errors. During a mouse drag, Ctrl+AltGraph+Arrow no longer moves the insert marker, and the round-267 regression (C-R267-01) is closed. I found one new Low; it doesn't fail the round.

**Checks:**
- **Scope:** only the 3 granted files changed. The code diff is round 267's lines plus the single new condition at l.2421, inside the keydown handler. The test file only gained lines.
- **Claims:** K2–K20 matched when re-run. K1 differs: HEAD is `e937046`, not the planned `7ba7cd2`, because root committed the product-designer agent files in between. The lessons' claims rule (L29) says a mismatch is a planning FAIL; I made an explicit exception because no app file differs between the two commits. The reason is written in the report.
- **Tests:** the 13 targeted files pass, 236/236. The slowest test in the changed file took 508 ms. Biome is clean on the 2 changed files.
- **Mutation tests:** every mutant turned its rows red: M-ARROW, M-GESTURE (AG5 and all four AG7 variants), M-AG, three per-branch mutants, and one extra of mine. The unmutated control passed 30/30.
- **Browser, during a drag:** none of the Alt or AltGraph chords moved the marker or showed the "let go first" message. Plain Ctrl+Arrow was still blocked with that message.
- **Browser, no drag:**
  - None of the Alt or AltGraph chords moved the marker.
  - Plain Ctrl+Arrow still jumped the marker from 7.500 to the clip end (101.352).
  - With a Mac browser identity, Alt+Arrow still moved it the same way.
- **Round-267 shortcut rows:** all behave as in round 267.
- **Doc 199:** status line exact, headings in order, every cited test row exists.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:**
  - `/studio-lab` opens anonymously with the demo notice and no logged-in user.
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio loaded.
  - `/api/studio-token` returns 401 without a header; with a fake token it returns 500 and no token.

**New Low, C-R268-01:** during playback, a Ctrl+Shift+Space event with AltGraph set but Alt not set still moves the insert marker to the playhead. Same result at both viewports. This is the gap A's code reviewer predicted, and it contradicts B's rule that no Alt or AltGraph chord runs a command anywhere in the keydown handler. That code is unchanged since HEAD and this round froze it, so it isn't a regression. No real platform is known to send this key combination. B should either defer it with the other Lows or narrow the rule's wording.

**Notes:**
- My first arrow-probe run timed out while the page loaded, because my test runs were using the machine at the same time. I logged it as invalid and the re-run alone was clean.
- Audio, export and video were not re-measured: this round only changed one keyboard condition.
- Full suite, build and verify are left to the root gate and not claimed.
